name: Leading Edge Data Centres CFS1 Coffs Harbour
notes: LEDC's current location page lists CFS1 in Coffs Harbour with 300kW total site capacity, 212 m2 available, Tier III design, dark fibre to the Coffs Harbour NBN POI, and booking/enquiry options. DCD reported the facility launch on 2022-12-02; LEDC earlier reported the DA for the Airport Enterprise Park site on 2021-01-20.

name: Project Pluto Data Centre
notes: NSW Planning Portal project SSD-69223466 shows Project Pluto Data Centre in Cumberland, decision approved, determination date 23/07/2026, and describes construction and operation of a 126MW-load data centre at 132 McCredie Road, Guildford West with two three-storey buildings, substations, ancillary office space, parking, landscaping, and demolition works. Trade reporting identifies Goodman as developer and notes a A$1.11bn approved campus.

name: Leading Edge Data Centres DBO1 Dubbo
notes: LEDC's current location page lists DBO1 in Dubbo with 750kW total site capacity, 580 m2 available, Tier III design, 375kW IT load capacity per module, dark fibre to the Dubbo NBN POI, and cloud on-ramps. LEDC announced in 2021 that the Jannali Road facility was being built, after an $11m development application.
